subject: Chloe Fineman
headline: chloe fineman already booked her post-snl job
body: she announced she was leaving saturday night live last week. netflix moved fast.
slide2: she's a series regular on myron bolitar, alongside jabari banks, jamie mcshane and ben mckenzie.

subject: Julia Garner
headline: julia garner's next role is a real murder case
body: apple's guilty creatures is adapted from a true crime book about a killing in tallahassee.
slide2: lewis pullman stars opposite her. garner also executive produces. craig gillespie directs.
